purpose: Show a home services or local business owner how calls get answered and jobs booked while they work, how customer details stay safe, and get them to start an AI check-up.

seo.title: AI for home services and local businesses | Alliance AI Partners
seo.description: An AI receptionist that answers your calls and books jobs while you work, built and run by an embedded AI team in the Philippines.

content.heading: Calls answered. Jobs booked.
content.lead: An AI receptionist answers your calls in a natural voice, asks what the customer needs and books the job into your calendar. When a caller needs a person, it takes a message for you.
body: Built and run by our team in the Philippines, as part of yours.

images.slotName: IMG-24-1 · A ribbon road between groves
images.source: Editorial illustration on a Daylight background at early evening, nearly square (about 1:1), safe to crop to 4:5 around the centre. Low, rounded faceted paper hills in slate blue and Partner Navy under a soft pale sky. A satin ribbon road in a gradient from Alliance Blue to Ribbon Cyan winds through the valley and links a series of small faceted tree groves one after another, each grove with one leaf catching the light: the next jobs on the route, booked in order. Keep the top third a calm, open sky. No houses, no vehicles, no tools. Palette only: Partner Navy #121B2A, Alliance Blue #1B56FF, Ribbon Cyan #00D5FF, Daylight #F4F7FB and the shades between them. Nature built from satin ribbon and flat paper facets. Light from the upper left, soft navy-tinted shadows falling down and to the right. No text or letters, no people, no hands, no robots, no brains, no circuit boards, no sparkles, no glow, no purple or pink, no regional or cultural motifs, no real places or landmarks.

sections.name: Section · Slow work
sections.job: Show we understand the slow, manual work in this industry before offering a fix (Brand DNA: listen first).
sections.desktop: Split: head column 520 (Heading/2 title, Body/LG lead) | four hairline rows on the right (Heading/4 title 300 | Body/Default text).
sections.mobile: Head, then the four rows stacked (title above text) between hairlines.

content.heading: The work that happens off the job.
content.lead: While you’re working, the phone keeps ringing, and a missed call can be a missed job.

items.title: Calls you can’t take
items.text: You’re up a ladder, under a sink or driving between jobs when the phone rings.

items.title: Voicemails to call back
items.text: Messages pile up, and by the time you call back the customer may have booked someone else.

items.title: Booking by back and forth
items.text: Finding a time that suits the customer and your calendar takes several calls or texts.

items.title: Enquiries after hours
items.text: Calls and messages that come in after you finish wait until the next morning.

sections.note: Descriptions of common manual work, written as the problem; no figures, no claims about how long anything takes.

content.heading: The home services and local businesses package.
content.lead: Call answering and job booking, packaged for home services and local businesses. Start there and add more over time.

items.title: Call answering
items.text: AI answers your calls in a natural voice and asks what the job is, where it is and how soon it’s needed.

items.title: Job booking
items.text: It finds a free slot in your calendar, books the job and confirms the details with the customer.

items.title: Messages for your team
items.text: When a caller needs a person, it takes a clear message and passes it straight to you.

images.source: Editorial illustration on a Daylight background, wide (about 2:1), safe to crop to 16:10 around the centre. At the left, a faceted paper swallow perches on a loose curl of satin ribbon in a gradient from Alliance Blue to Ribbon Cyan, beak open as it answers; at the right, a second swallow flies in toward it: a call made and a call answered. Calm, open Daylight space between and above them. Palette only: Partner Navy #121B2A, Alliance Blue #1B56FF, Ribbon Cyan #00D5FF, Daylight #F4F7FB and the shades between them. Nature built from satin ribbon and flat paper facets. Light from the upper left, soft navy-tinted shadows falling down and to the right. No text or letters, no people, no hands, no robots, no brains, no circuit boards, no sparkles, no glow, no purple or pink, no regional or cultural motifs, no real places or landmarks.

content.heading: AI picks up. You stay on the job.
content.lead: A sample of how one evening call moves through the package. We map your real steps with your team before we build.

items.text: A customer calls about a leak after you’ve finished for the day.
The AI receptionist answers and asks what’s wrong, where and how soon.
It finds the first free slot in your calendar and books it.
The customer gets the booking details by text.
You see the new job, with notes, in your calendar.

images.source: UI composition drawn in Figma (not a raster): a Partner 30 panel with a "Sample" tag, the title "One evening call", and the numbered steps above, each tagged with who does it.
images.alt: Sample: One evening call, step by step.

sections.note: A sample, labelled as one; no times, volumes or results.

sections.name: Section · Services
sections.job: List the services that work alongside the package, with published starting prices where they exist and a fixed quote otherwise.

sections.mobile: Head; the six Service rows (Mobile variant) in one column; link.

content.heading: Add more when you’re ready.
content.lead: These services work well alongside the home services and local businesses package. You get a fixed quote before any work starts.

items.title: Messaging assistants
items.text: Replies to customers on WhatsApp, SMS, Instagram and Facebook Messenger.

items.title: Back-office automation
items.text: Data entry, inbox sorting, invoice matching and HR paperwork, handled by AI.

items.title: CRM automation and lead scoring
items.text: Your CRM stays up to date on its own, and leads are ranked so your team calls the best ones first.

items.title: AI search visibility (GEO)
items.text: We help your business show up in answers from ChatGPT, Google’s AI results, Perplexity and other AI search tools.

items.title: AI automation
items.text: One slow process handled by AI and checked by a person.

items.title: Websites and web apps
items.text: A fast, accessible site or web app, built and kept running.

sections.note: Only the launch services carry a starting price ([PRICE]); every other row says "Fixed quote", which is the Brand DNA pricing promise (a fixed quote before work starts).

sections.name: Section · Data
sections.job: Say how the partner’s data stays safe, in Brand DNA promises only, with the one sourced legal fact.
sections.desktop: Whole Partner Navy chapter. Section head (Heading/1 title with the cyan accent 0.9fr | Body/LG lead 1.1fr). A 2x2 grid of promises between hairlines: cyan UI icon (24) | Heading/4 title (the law item carries Source key 1) and Body/Default text. Cyan underlined link, then the numbered source list.
sections.mobile: Head stacked; the four promises as one column of hairline rows (icon | title and text); link; source list.

content.heading: Caller details stay yours.
content.lead: Names, addresses and phone numbers stay where you decide, in your own systems wherever possible.

items.title: Never used for training
items.text: We never use your data to train anything you don’t own.

items.title: A person checks the work
items.text: A person reviews every piece of work before it reaches you.

items.title: An owner and a backup plan
items.text: Every automation has both, so a caller it can’t help still gets a message to you.

items.title: Protected by law
items.text: Personal data in the Philippines is protected by the Data Privacy Act of 2012, enforced by an independent National Privacy Commission.

sources.text: Republic Act No. 10173, Data Privacy Act of 2012. Supreme Court E-Library. Retrieved 2026-11-02.

content.lead: The AI check-up is our usual first project. We learn how your business works, find where AI could save you time or money, and hand you a written plan with a fixed quote for the first fix.

items.text: The whole check-up, at a fixed price

items.title: [two weeks]
items.text: From the first call to your written plan

notes: Built from the shared industry template. The Brand DNA package is "Call answering and job booking"; the third card (messages for your team) is part of the Brand DNA AI voice agents service ("takes messages"), not a new package item. The sample call names no times beyond "after you’ve finished for the day" and no results. No promise that every call is answered.
